findings.summary: Forced-pass axiom A6 added to AXIOMS.md §2; registered in CLAIMS.md §2.6a
findings.detail: The forced pass — a player with no legal placement passes, and the pass is indistinguishable from a voluntary one — was an unwritten axiom implicit in src/exp6_solve.zig:926-929 (pinned 082433e), which emits the pass edge unconditionally. Added as A6 in AXIOMS.md §2 block A, claim ID GLOBAL.AXIOM-FORCEDPASS, status CLAIMED at birth. The artifact records 516,242 terminal-bit states at 4×4 where a side cannot place (build T184, 2026-08-01, docs/evidence/ORACLE-V2/build-T184-2026-08-01.stdout:162). Depends on A5 (pass always legal); feeds Z-R-MOVE and Z-R-SCORE.

findings.summary: Scope statement: handicap and arbitrary-start explicitly out of scope
findings.detail: The census seeds only the empty goban for either side at passes=0 (src/exp6_solve.zig:964-969). The model has no handicap concept and no arbitrary-start concept. This was a decided exclusion, not an oversight. Added to AXIOMS.md §6 as an explicit 'out of scope (model)' bullet.
